channel.title: govbot — Chicago citywide: candidates on upcoming ballots
channel.description: All Chicago citywide races govbot is tracking on upcoming Chicago/Illinois ballots, refreshed twice daily.

item.title: Mayor
item.description: On the ballot 2027-02-23. No candidates confirmed yet. Timeline: Petition circulation begins ~Oct 1, 2026 · Filing deadline ~Nov 23, 2026 · Objection period & ballot certification ~Dec 5, 2026 · Early voting & vote by mail begin ~Jan 30, 2027 · Election Day — municipal general Feb 23, 2027 · Runoff (if no majority) Apr 6, 2027 · Term begins / inauguration ~May 17, 2027. Chicago's citywide chief executive. On the 2027 municipal ballot — a non-partisan race; if no candidate wins a majority, the top two advance to an April runoff.
